note: The console buttons' press animation (re/screens/starmap.md §10.6, deviations row 224): the pitch button (hot-spot 6) held with the left button, then the zoom button (5) held with the right one; a held button shows `kezel.xvb`'s sub-mesh at frame 5, back to 0 on the release. The exe draws its first frames only ~100 ticks into the script (its grabs before that come late and its events there are lost), so everything starts at t 150. Times are UI ticks from the script's first frame. The pointer leaves the console 5 ticks after each press (the held spot stays latched, `Mouse_Megfogva`) so the exe's cursor doesn't cover the button. Compare a held grab with the client's still `--console-held 6` / `5` (`--exe-png`, `--client-arg`).
